entries.zh: 心火平息，愁怒止息（忧愁恼怒渐平，如“凉心火”）
entries.en: for the grief/sorrow to subside, the heart's fire to be cooled (anger or distress calming down)

entries.zh: 痊愈，病愈（病情平复好转）
entries.en: for an illness to abate; to recover, to get better

entries.zh: 扁，压扁的；凹瘪变形
entries.en: flattened; dented, crushed in
entries.notes: M 栏声调标记 T99 污损难辨；“扁/压扁”义四栏互证仍清晰

entries.zh: 平息，安抚（西栏义；汉字“聰”与之对应不明，释义存疑）
entries.en: to appease, to calm, to soothe (Chinese correspondence unclear)
entries.notes: M 栏 T99 污损；“Aplacar”（平息）与汉字“聰”、音写 feñg/hēng 无常规对应，语义无法定夺

entries.zh: 修善，修养善德；效法仿行善行
entries.en: to apply oneself to virtue; to follow and imitate it
entries.notes: 句尾缩写 “mirar tud.” 未能确解，不影响“修善”主体释义

entries.zh: 悭吝，吝啬小气；卑贱寒酸
entries.en: mean, stingy, miserly; wretched, paltry

entries.zh: 悭悋，吝啬（原稿第二字“悸/悋”存疑）
entries.en: mean, miserly (second Chinese character uncertain: 悸 or 悋)
entries.notes: 汉字栏 [疑:悸/悋]，按“悭吝”常语释义

entries.zh: 鄙吝，卑鄙悭吝；鄙陋寒酸
entries.en: base and stingy, mean-spirited; sordid, miserable

entries.zh: 怯懦胆小，怕得不敢作声（汉字“有尻”与音写同西栏不合，释义存疑）
entries.en: cowardly, timid; fearful and speechless (Chinese gloss unclear)
entries.notes: 汉字“有尻”与音写 pa puy/pâng pŷⁿ 同“胆怯不言”无法对应，语义无法定夺

entries.zh: 寸心烦乱，心绪不宁（胆怯而心中愁扰）
entries.en: timid, with an anguished heart; troubled and distressed in mind

entries.zh: 急心，心急性躁——事放不进心里、按捺不住
entries.en: hasty, impatient of heart; unable to contain things within one's heart

entries.zh: 培土，壅土（于作物根际培土）
entries.en: to earth up, to bank soil around (plants)
entries.notes: M 栏声调标记 T99 污损；“培/培土”义四栏互证仍清晰

entries.zh: 培土养护树木；培育
entries.en: to earth up trees; to nurse, to cultivate (trees)

entries.zh: 湾船，使船入湾停泊、进港泊岸
entries.en: to put the ship into port, to moor the vessel in a bay/harbor

entries.zh: 留宿，留人住宿（留客安置过夜）
entries.en: to lodge, to put up (a guest); q. hospedar = to receive and lodge

entries.zh: 栖身寄宿（三栏互不合，释义存疑）
entries.en: to lodge, to settle oneself (Chinese correspondence unclear)
entries.notes: M 栏 'se'、R 栏 'mŷ'、汉字录作“迷”彼此不符，无法定夺

entries.zh: 安身，安顿栖身；落脚安住
entries.en: to settle oneself, to find lodging; to establish one's abode

entries.zh: 楼，楼上居室（屋之上层房间）
entries.en: an upper room, an upper story of a house

entries.zh: 楼上
entries.en: the upper floor/story, upstairs

entries.zh: 楼顶，楼上（楼的上层）
entries.en: the top of the building; the upper floor, upstairs

entries.zh: 楼阁，多层楼阁（M 栏涂删不清，据汉字与官话对音释义）
entries.en: a storied building, a tower or pavilion
entries.notes: M 栏涂删不清且 T99 污损，仅据汉字“樓閣”与 R 栏对音释义

entries.zh: （妇女）闭居深藏于内（“間”字与音写对应不明，释义存疑）
entries.en: (women) housed and kept secluded indoors; seclusion of women (Chinese correspondence unclear)
entries.notes: 汉字“間”与音写 cûm/cûin 无常规对应，仅据西栏“妇女被安置深藏”释义

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西栏[残]，汉字与闽南音写两栏[空]，仅存官话对音 'vay.'，无从定夺
